### Observed differences

- In the later window, the outgoing transitions of A33 shifted: A30 became the more frequent successor (about 57% of observed transitions, up from about 38% before), while A34 decreased (about 43%, down from about 62%). [DIR001]
- In the later window, the outgoing transitions of A34 also shifted: A33 became the more frequent successor (about 57%, up from about 38% before), while A30 decreased (about 43%, down from about 62%). [DIR002]
- Both profiles are based on roughly 100 traces containing the source activity in each window. [DIR001, DIR002]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a change in the process. Only two control-flow items were observed when fewer than one would be expected by chance, so the observed shift in successor frequencies between A33 and A34 is within what an unchanged process can produce.
